widget.name: Status Timeline Chart
widget.description: Counts items per status per period from a list of status changes and shows the result as stacked bars, a stacked area or lines. No helper entities or microflows needed.

property.caption: Status changes
property.description: The list of status-change records, one object per change (e.g. an audit or history entity). Use an XPath constraint to keep only status changes and to limit the time span: all matching objects are loaded.

property.caption: Change date
property.description: When the change happened (may be reached over an association). Each change is placed in the period that contains this date.

property.caption: New status
property.description: The status the item moved INTO with this change. It may hold the status name or the status object's id: with the "Statuses" list filled in, ids are turned into names automatically.

property.caption: Item ID
property.description: Something unique per item (e.g. its number), so the widget knows which changes belong to the same item. Required for "Snapshot at period end", not used by "Changes per period".

property.caption: Statuses
property.description: Optional list of all statuses, sorted the way you want them stacked (first = bottom). Turns status ids into names, sets the order in chart and legend, and shows statuses with 0 items.

property.caption: Status name
property.description: The display name of a status. Should match the text in "New status" when that holds names.

property.caption: Status color
property.description: Optional CSS color stored on the status object (e.g. #E74C3C). Wins over "Status colors" on the Statuses tab.

property.caption: What to count
property.description: Snapshot: how many items were in each status at the END of each period (each item counted once, in the status of its latest change). Changes: how many changes INTO each status happened in each period.

property.caption: Period
property.description: The size of one bar or point on the time axis.

property.caption: Periods to show
property.description: How many periods to show, counting back from the last one (Month + 12 = the last 12 months). 0 shows everything from the first change on.

property.caption: Last period
property.description: Today: the chart ends with the current period, also when nothing changed recently. Last change: it ends with the period of the newest change in the data.

property.caption: Week starts on
property.description: Only used when Period = Week.

property.caption: Chart style
property.description: Stacked columns: one column per period, split by status (best for totals). Columns: one column per status, side by side in each period (best for comparing statuses in a period). Stacked area: a filled area over time. Lines: one line per status. With the style switcher on, this is the style the chart starts with.

property.caption: Title
property.description: Optional title shown above the chart.

property.caption: Height (px)
property.description: Height of the chart area in pixels. The width always follows the container.

property.caption: Show totals
property.description: Stacked styles and Columns: writes the total of each period above it. Lines: adds a dashed "Total" line.

property.caption: Show grid lines
property.description: Light horizontal lines behind the chart to help read values.

property.caption: Show style switcher
property.description: Shows a row of buttons above the chart so users can switch between chart styles on the page. Off: the chart always uses "Chart style".

property.caption: Offer stacked columns
property.description: Show a "Stacked columns" button in the style switcher.

property.caption: Offer columns
property.description: Show a "Columns" (side by side) button in the style switcher.

property.caption: Offer stacked area
property.description: Show a "Stacked area" button in the style switcher.

property.caption: Offer lines
property.description: Show a "Lines" button in the style switcher.

property.caption: Remember choice
property.description: The browser remembers the style each user picked for this widget (by its name), also after a page reload. Off: every page visit starts with "Chart style".

property.caption: Status colors
property.description: Optional fixed colors per status name, separated by ";", e.g. Open=#E74C3C; Done=#27AE60. Other statuses get the default palette.

property.caption: Hide statuses
property.description: Status names to leave out, separated by ";", e.g. Done; Cancelled. Use (empty) for changes without a status.

property.caption: Status order
property.description: Stacking order when no "Statuses" list is set, separated by ";" (first = bottom). Statuses not listed come after, alphabetically.

property.caption: X axis title
property.description: Optional text under the time axis, e.g. "Month".

property.caption: Y axis title
property.description: Optional text next to the count axis, e.g. "Items".

property.caption: Date label format
property.description: Optional format of the period labels; empty = automatic. Tokens: d, dd, MMM, MMMM, MM, yy, yyyy, W (week), Q (quarter). Text in quotes is kept, e.g. 'Week' W.

property.caption: Show legend
property.description: Shows which color belongs to which status. Click a status in the legend to hide or show it.

property.caption: Legend position
property.description: Where the legend is placed around the chart.
